posts.name: Comrade Bubbles
posts.cooked:
I've been debating this for a while now, but you people seem nice enough. I run a gaming blog that I've recently redesigned and, to be honest, it's still finding its feet and could do with me passing the link around more.

 I wasn't going to post the link but the mention of TitansGrave in another thread made me reconsider because I'm currently about a third of the way through posting my adventure series for it on my site. If you're interested, that can be found here.

If gaming related fiction is more your thing, that can be found here.

These are the articles I cooked up as an introduction to role-playing for a friend. I plan on expanding the list that can be found here.

And for good measure, this is the last of the pages.

 

Anyway, I hope you find something you like. Comments and criticisms are welcome, both here and on the site. I'll also remove this post if asked.
